prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for an early 2010 touchscreen fruit slicing game. TRUE transparent background, exact 4 columns x 4 rows, equal square cells, no outer margins, no visible grid. Sixteen independent sprites, each fully contained inside central 75% of its cell. Painterly photorealistic 3D fruit game graphics with rich texture and glossy directional lighting, mature arcade style, NOT cute faces, NOT flat vector, NOT emoji, NO words or numbers. Row 1 left to right: whole round green striped WATERMELON; whole red APPLE with small green leaf; whole juicy ORANGE; whole yellow PINEAPPLE with spiky leaves. Row 2: whole brown fuzzy KIWI; whole green PEAR; whole red STRAWBERRY; black spherical CARTOON BOMB with visible rope fuse and tiny orange spark, brushed black metal texture, no writing. Row 3: a juicy watermelon HALF showing circular red flesh and black seeds; a red apple HALF showing cream flesh and brown seeds; an orange HALF showing bright segmented orange flesh; a pineapple HALF showing yellow fibrous flesh and rind with crown. Row 4: kiwi HALF with green flesh, pale center and radial black seeds; pear HALF showing ivory flesh and dark seeds; strawberry HALF showing red flesh, pale core and skin seeds; coconut HALF showing white flesh with dark fibrous shell (spare). The halves each show juicy cut surface facing camera with a visible outer rind depth; suitable for two copies flying apart and spinning after a cut. Whole fruit and halves match species and textures exactly. Each cell one isolated object, evenly scaled, no overlap, transparent gaps; square canvas 2048x2048 if possible.

Use case: stylized-concept. Fullscreen landscape 16:9 background texture for an early 2010 classic fruit-slicing touchscreen arcade game, a worn dojo chopping wall of warm rich medium brown wooden planks. Six wide HORIZONTAL timber planks across whole width, darker fine joints, aged honey brown oak grain and knots, subtle old blade scratches, slightly scuffed edges, photographic hand-painted game texture with soft warm diffuse lighting. Flat orthographic front view, detailed real wood. Center brighter and clean enough for flying fruit; subtle dark vignette at corners but overall legible. No UI, no fruits, no objects, no weapons, no text, no symbols, no logos, no decorative frames, no perspective, no background beyond the wood. Match the nostalgic juicy arcade aesthetic, not a pale modern kitchen and not cartoon vector. Full bleed edge-to-edge wood.
